blocks.tamil_translation: — how shall we renew it?” it was asked. Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Keep saying “La ilaha illallah' (this Kalimah) abundantly!”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: أَفْضَلُ الذِّكْرِ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَأَفْضَلُ الدُّعَاءِ اَلْحَمْدُ للهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب ماجاء ان دعوة المسلم مستجابة، رقم:٣٣٨٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates: “I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: “The best of Dhikr is La ilaha illallah, and the best of Du'a is Alhamdu lillah.””

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The foundation of the whole Deen rests upon this. Without this Kalimah, Iman is not valid, and no one can become a Muslim. That is why “La ilaha illallah' (this Kalimah) has been called the best Dhikr of all.
Praising a noble person is (a way of) asking from him. Asking from Allah Ta'ala is what is called Du'a! That is why “Alhamdu lillah” has been called the best Du'a.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عََنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَاقَالَ عَبْدٌ لاٰ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللهُ قَطُّ مُخْلِصاً إِلَّا فُتِحتْ لَهُ أَبْوَابُ السَّمَاءِ حَتَّي تُفْضِيَ إِلَي الْعَرْشِ مَا اجْتَنَبَ الْكَبَائِرَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن غريب، باب دعاء أم سلمة ﵂، رقم:٣٥٩٠.
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whenever a servant says La ilaha illallah with sincerity of heart, as long as the one saying it keeps away from the major sins, the doors of the heavens are opened for this Kalimah, and it never fails to reach directly up to the Arsh. (This Kalimah is accepted immediately.)” so said the Prophet ﷺ, as Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA)
